svg.title: In Germany the GDP index rose while the emissions index fell
svg.desc: Dot chart: In Germany the GDP index rose while the emissions index fell: GDP: 100.0 in 2000, 102.0 in 2004, 111.0 in 2008, 113.8 in 2012, 121.3 in 2016, 122.1 in 2020, 127.4 in 2024; Emissions: 100.0 in 2000, 99.1 in 2004, 95.2 in 2008, 91.8 in 2012, 90.6 in 2016, 73.7 in 2020, 66.5 in 2024.
